_about: Wall-panel wall spec, AP Capital main level: OFFICE (TM 252137 rev 2, PDF 2026-02-24 - no DWG). mm, wall-local: x along the wall from its left end as seen from the room (niche walls: as seen from inside the niche), z up from the SUBFLOOR (survey zero), y = 0 at the wall face, negative toward the room. Survey = ~/Documents/AP_MF_Office_v1.0.skp (probe 862 / 863). Andriy 2026-10-19: panels on walls A and B only, 'as the kitchen' (heights from the subfloor, FFL +57.15; NO stone plinth - panels 10 above FFL; 10 to the ceiling, joints 10 open, inside corners: the long wall runs through), TM design kept and fitted to the survey; the three niches of wall A lined with 4 panels each (2 sides, back, soffit); niche sides MDF 22 glued without a frame so the TM bases 450 fit (515 - 2 x 22 = 471). Wall A = TM wall A (panels 1-13): TM grid kept, widths from the survey (TM 6010.5, survey 6052); upper row = TM 1246 less 6.7 (bottom at the niche soffit face, one joint all round 2440.7 / 2450.7).
